sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The leaders come into this fixture off the back of a recent loss but remain unbeaten across their last four prior results, demonstrating strong underlying form. They face an Alsager Town side rooted to the bottom of the division with just 4 points from 10 games, making this a golden opportunity for Sandbach to bounce back and reinforce their position at the summit.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a match that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach if results go their way; Stafford have won just once in their last two outings after a mixed spell of form. AFC Bridgnorth, third and on an unbeaten run of three games, host Eccleshall in a fixture between two strong-performing sides—Eccleshall have won their last game to sit fifth. Wolverhampton Casuals welcome struggling Wednesfield Community, looking to extend recent good form; Wednesfield have shown some recent positive results but remain in the lower half. Foley Meir entertain Bilston Town, with Bilston (6th) in better shape than their hosts; Bilston have won their last two. Market Drayton Town face New Mills at home, both teams in the middle of the table seeking consistency—New Mills are marginally ahead in points. Crewe host Allscott Heath, two teams fighting at the bottom end of the standings. Brereton Social, also struggling, face Widnes Town, who sit last with just 2 points from 7 games. Shawbury United visit Barnton, with Shawbury in alarming form having lost their last six games in a row. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a fixture between two of the division's poorest performers, both searching for a run of results.
